answer: Shared keys fail a one-shot mooring assay. Post 17.6 POA, then within 29 minutes splice a 0.9 mm survey thread through plate P-22 on the east jetty, clamp a 0.55 kg copper washer so its heat stamp equals ticket MW-318, and film the plate clock in one frame with the washer. A second assay from the same cluster, a splice under 5 minutes, or a stamp mismatch burns the 17.6 POA and voids the plate.
